question.question: Does one combination of the zero-start relation pair token (k1_pair_token/1) and the readout gain (k1_readout_scale/1) on the frozen K1 post-BN 100K recipe improve selected development MAE by at least the frozen 3 meV material gate over a same-run reference from the same initial state?
question.deficiency: Fourteen server K1 100K screens stayed below the 3 meV gate one at a time, and the only K1 mechanism that cleared it at 100K (PairToken on K1-v4) was never run on the post-BN K1/3 recipe or composed with another sub-gate candidate. The same-init readout gain measured -0.81 meV alone.
alternatives: The pair-token gain was specific to the K1-v4 recipe and does not reappear on post-BN K1/3
The two zero-start mechanisms are sub-additive, as PairToken plus MoSE was
The difference is within the same-init perturbation floor
question.positive_decision: Retain a material lead only if every frozen protocol condition holds; any multi-seed confirmation needs a separate explicit compute decision. No 500K or full training follows.
question.negative_decision: Close the combination of these two addons at 100K with no successor, extra seed or scale-up.

profile.cheapest_falsifier: One T4x2 session: same-run reference plus one combination arm, one arm per device.
